history.title: Fix B2 as the unified cross-object branch rule (Build A only)
history.proposition: An ASM relative branch whose target lies in a different link object is emitted symbolically when it is rel32 to an exported entry. Otherwise it is emitted with its original literal displacement iff (a) every byte between source and target is supplied in place (ASM pieces of original length or C objects placed in sequence; never legacy layout), (b) a target inside a C object lies within that object's VerifiedRegion, and (c) the final wc1.compare is IDENTICAL. Otherwise the plan is rejected. Each such branch is recorded as Build A placement debt in build output and in a test. Joint TUs (DEC-B06) are preferred when available.
